findings: Original unexecuted V1 findings remain preserved; current tool confines safe errors to exception type and fixed GateError codes.
Exact Z10 manifest path/duty and zerDe automation identity, anchor/deadline and actual registration receipt hashes are required before SDK/API; semantics were independently negatively tested.

Wall date/retention bounds plus monotonic 600 seconds and 30 second API reserve are enforced before API, after response, after capture and at completion. A late synthetic response left INTENT, no raw and no second call.

Valid claim failures retain PARTIAL and consumed once; ledger hash failure still permits a partial report. Preclaim filesystem/lock/PRE failures remain external rejection rather than a promised internal receipt.

Independent requires completed main role/label, strict integer 38 or 40 count, exact anchor/deadline, ordered call/ledger prefix and response hashes/identity. Invalid handoff fixtures stopped before transport.
New news revision 0 is legal. Free repair_note is never copied into safe summary; missing and ABSENT counters remain distinct, and bool counters are rejected.
Prior module is imported only for pure metadata/table/step validation; no ended entry, prior private snapshot, business writer, model, UI or retry path is invoked.
Sequential metadata observations do not establish native Telegram visibility, full news manifest, natural sample acceptance, current budget/model permission or global transaction.
